name: 11796 · West Sayville, NY
findings: ZIP 11796 (West Sayville) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11796 (West Sayville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11796 (West Sayville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
